title: Twill
description: A 2/2 twill strengthens float by float along the diagonal.
alt: Slim rounded bars, peach, blue and rose across and pale linen down, strengthen in a diagonal sweep to form the slanted ribs of a twill cloth, then fade back to a faint trace.
note: Giving the rule for the weave as arithmetic, weft on top where (column − row) mod 4 is 0 or 1, yields a correct twill. Grouping the floats by diagonal lets one delay per group drive a hundred shapes and keeps the file small. The floats were first twice as thick and read as heavy next to the thread entries. A later pass made the loop rest on a faint trace instead of an empty square.
author: Maria Roszyk
